note: Seed data for institutional memory (Phase 4). These are human-approved conclusions from a prior engagement. Not used by the MVP; retrieved later to ground current-year testing in how this team concluded before.

concluded_controls.title: Periodic access reviews
concluded_controls.evidence_quote: Access reviews are performed periodically by system owners.
concluded_controls.reviewer_reasoning: Prior year we accepted 'periodically' as a partial only — the team's standard is that access-review controls require an explicit quarterly (or tighter) cadence to be considered fully documented. 'Periodically' does not establish frequency.
concluded_controls.conclusion: Partial — documented that reviews occur, but no defined cadence. Same treatment expected in the current year unless the policy now names a frequency.

concluded_controls.title: Access revocation on termination
concluded_controls.evidence_quote: Access is revoked within one business day of termination.
concluded_controls.reviewer_reasoning: Prior year the policy said 'one business day'; the team accepted that as meeting the 24-hour requirement. Treat an explicit sub-24-hour or one-business-day commitment as sufficient.
concluded_controls.conclusion: Documented. The bar the team set: a specific, bounded revocation window (<= 24h or one business day).

concluded_controls.title: Annual independent penetration testing
concluded_controls.reviewer_reasoning: No penetration testing policy existed in the prior year either; this was raised as a documentation gap in the FY2025 report.
concluded_controls.conclusion: Not found — recurring gap. Expect to raise again if still undocumented.
